description: Source code for the GTP-U demultiplexer implementation, including tunnel management, error indication, and PDU handling.

classes.name: gtpu_demux_impl
classes.description: Implementation of GTP-U demuxer handling PDU routing, tunnel management, and error reporting.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the demuxer by setting the stopped flag.

methods.name: set_error_indication_tx
methods.description: Configures the transmission of error indications, parsing the local address to set peer address info.

methods.name: send_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs and sends a GTP-U error indication message for a specific TEID and source address.

methods.name: add_tunnel
methods.description: Adds a new tunnel for a given TEID, creating a dispatch queue for PDU handling.

methods.name: remove_tunnel
methods.description: Removes a tunnel associated with a specific TEID.

methods.name: apply_test_teid
methods.description: Sets a test TEID for testing mode.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming PDU, routing it to the appropriate tunnel or dropping it if not found.

methods.name: write_pcap
methods.description: Writes a PDU to PCAP if enabled.

methods.name: handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Forwards a PDU to the associated tunnel after logging and optional PCAP writing.
